indication_area: Respiratory (asthma, bronchospasm in reversible obstructive airway disease)
revenue_scope: Sepracor net sales of XOPENEX HFA (levalbuterol tartrate) Inhalation Aerosol, reported separately from XOPENEX Inhalation Solution
geography: Customers in the United States and Canada (Sepracor: 'All of our revenues in 2008, 2007 and 2006 were received from unaffiliated customers located in the United States and Canada'); the product is marketed in the U.S.

approval_evidence.quote: This new drug application provides for the use of Xopenex HFA (levalbuterol tartrate) Inhalation Aerosol for treatment or prevention of bronchospasm in adults, adolescents, and children 4 years of age and older with reversible obstructive airway disease. ... It is approved, effective on the date of this letter (NDA 21-730; Drugs@FDA lists the original approval on 03/11/2005).

launch_evidence.quote: Sepracor launched XOPENEX HFA in December 2005, and revenues for XOPENEX HFA were approximately $12.0 million in 2005 due principally to stocking of the product.

series_end_reason: Sepracor became an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary of Dainippon Sumitomo Pharma when the merger took effect on October 20, 2009 (Form 8-K filed 2009-10-20, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/877357/000110465909059627/a09-31878_18k.htm), so its last periodic filing is the Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2009 (filed 2009-08-05). The Sepracor Fact Book 2009 (November 2009, on the Sumitomo Pharma IR site) itemises XOPENEX HFA for the quarter ended September 30, 2009 and is the last document to do so. From 2010Q1 Sumitomo Pharma's supplementary financial data print one XOPENEX line (levalbuterol HCI) with no XOPENEX HFA split, which is held as the continuation companion sepracor_xopenex_hfa_cont.
notes: Series is the XOPENEX HFA line only (Sepracor reports XOPENEX Inhalation Solution on a separate line; the brand total is not used). Sepracor restated 2007 quarters in Forms 10-Q/A filed 2008-05-07 (Q2 2007 $12.4 million restated from $12.3 million, Q3 2007 $17.1 million from $17.3 million); the restated figures are used for 2007Q2 and 2007Q3 and agree with the fourth-quarter 2007 release and full-year 2007. 2006Q1-2006Q3 are read from the prior-year columns of the 2007 filings because the 2006 Forms 10-Q print whole dollars ($5,355,000; $1,591,000; $13,099,000), which the unit field cannot carry; full-year 2006 is 40,968 thousand and the four rows sum to 40.9. Fourth quarters 2006-2008 are derived as annual less nine months from the 10-K product table. Full-year check: 2008 rows sum to 74.1 against 74,213 thousand printed; 2007 rows sum to 74.9 against 74,883 thousand. Sumitomo Pharma (Sunovion) continues to sell XOPENEX HFA; its single 'XOPENEX' line (2010Q1-2020Q4 in the supplementary data) carries no formulation split, so it is not spliced and is held as the continuation companion sepracor_xopenex_hfa_cont. 2009Q3 is read from the Sepracor Fact Book 2009 (USD thousands, 22,825); the Fact Book's nine months to September 2009 is 57,711, and the 10-Q rows 20.1 + 14.8 plus 22.825 give 57.725 (rounding).
search_log: EDGAR submissions for Sepracor (CIK 877357, now named Sunovion Pharmaceuticals Inc.) listed with data.sec.gov; every 10-Q, 10-Q/A, 10-K, 10-K/A and Item 2.02 8-K from 2005 to 2009 considered (8-K/A: none in the window).

Extracted every 'Sales of XOPENEX HFA were' sentence from the 2005-2009 Forms 10-Q and 10-Q/A and the fourth-quarter release prose; 2005 Forms 10-Q (filed 2005-05-10, 2005-08-09, 2005-11-08) contain no XOPENEX HFA sales sentence and the 2006 Forms 10-Q state $0 for each 2005 quarter, so the first sales quarter is 2005Q4.
Q4 2005 release: sentence 'revenues for XOPENEX HFA were approximately $12.0 million in 2005' (launch December 2005); the FY2005 Form 10-K/A (filed 2006-09-12) gives 11,958 thousand.
Quarterly releases for Q1-Q3 2006 (8-K filed 2006-04-25, 2006-07-21, 2006-10-26) carry no XOPENEX HFA sales figure; the 10-Qs print whole dollars, hence prior-year-column rows from 2007 filings.
Sumitomo Pharma supplementary data (ebr*.pdf, 2010Q1 onwards) searched: only a combined XOPENEX line, no HFA line; no other issuer or royalty holder prints XOPENEX HFA separately after 2009Q2.
FDA approval letter for NDA 21-730 (accessdata.fda.gov appletter/2005/21730ltr.pdf) read for the approval wording; Drugs@FDA overview lists ORIG-1 approval 03/11/2005.

Refresh pass: Sumitomo Pharma supplementary financial data (sumitomo-pharma.com/ir/library/financial_results_summary/, every ebr*.pdf from 2009 to 2026 downloaded and text-searched for 'XOPENEX HFA'): no match; the only document that prints 'Product Revenue - Xopenex HFA' after the 10-Qs is the Sepracor Fact Book 2009 (ir20091112_2.pdf), which gives 22,825 and 18,526 thousand for the quarters ended September 30, 2009 and 2008 (2008Q3 = 18.5 in this series). Added as 2009Q3.

Sumitomo Pharma's Fact Books (fb201006-fb201211) describe XOPENEX as one brand with XOPENEX I.S. (inhalation solution, 1999) and XOPENEX HFA (2005); the supplementary 'XOPENEX (levalbuterol HCI)' line 2010Q1-2020Q4 is therefore a brand line that does not split the formulations; it is held as the continuation companion, not spliced. Its FY2020 Q3 release (ebr20210128.2.pdf) is the last to print it.
